description: Parking Bays in the London Borough of Southwark is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Southwark London Borough Council. This dataset consists of polygons showing the extent of parking bays on the highway maintained at public expense by Southwark. Attributes include any day and time restrictions as well as estimated number of spaces. Coverage: Southwark London Borough Council. The portal files it under the publisher Southwark London Borough Council. The portal shows 2018-03-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
